title: Error: llama runner process has terminated
summary: Often caused by out-of-memory (OOM) issues or incompatible CUDA drivers. The solution involves downgrading drivers or setting OLLAMA_KEEP_ALIVE=0.

title: Cannot connect to Ollama from Docker container
summary: How to correctly set the OLLAMA_HOST environment variable to 0.0.0.0 to allow external network connections from other Docker containers like Open WebUI.

title: High CPU usage when idle on Windows
summary: Resolving background processes not terminating correctly on Windows subsystem by configuring the sleep duration and verifying WSL2 settings.

title: GPU Not Detected — NVIDIA/AMD
summary: Ollama fails to detect your GPU at startup. This guide covers NVIDIA CUDA driver requirements and AMD ROCm setup for Linux.

title: CORS error when calling Ollama API from browser
summary: When calling the Ollama REST API directly from a browser-side JavaScript app, you may encounter CORS errors. Set OLLAMA_ORIGINS to fix this.

title: GGUF model import fails with 'invalid model'
summary: Some GGUF files downloaded from HuggingFace are incompatible with Ollama's parser. Converting with llama.cpp or choosing the correct quant resolves this.

title: Slow inference speed — GPU not utilized
summary: Inference runs on CPU even though a GPU is present. This is usually due to missing ROCm/CUDA libraries or mismatched quantization format.

title: Docker GPU not recognized inside container
summary: Running Ollama in Docker without --gpus=all or without NVIDIA Container Toolkit causes the GPU to be invisible inside the container.

title: Model download stuck or extremely slow
summary: ollama pull hangs or downloads at <1 MB/s. Proxy settings, DNS issues, or regional server routing are common causes.

title: Linux install script fails — permission denied
summary: The official install.sh script requires sudo. If it fails with permission errors, check your shell configuration and /usr/local/bin write access.

title: BoolWithDefault returns true for invalid env var values
summary: BoolWithDefault function returns true when strconv.ParseBool fails to parse values like 'yes', 'on', 'enabled'. Should return defaultValue instead.

title: Qwen2-VL-2B GGUF model fails to recognize images
summary: Qwen2-VL-2B GGUF model works with llama.cpp but cannot recognize images in Ollama. Vision capabilities may be lost during GGUF conversion.
